_comment: Managed mode, prefill/decode disaggregated on MI300X: 2 prefill pods and 1 decode pod, 8 GPUs and TP=8 each. DeepSeek-R1-0528 is the same repo MAD's pyt_vllm_deepseek-r1 model benchmarks standalone; here it is served through llm-d instead, which is where disaggregation actually pays off for a model this size. madengine stands the stack up, benchmarks it, and tears it back down.
